title: organization_receipt
description: One itemized gift to a committee from an organization: a corporation, union, trade association, tribe or other group that is neither an individual nor a committee. Grouped by organization key, never resolved, and never a contribution. Partitioned by cycle.

cycle.description: The two-year election cycle, named by its even year.

source.description: Where the row comes from. `fec` for every row of v1.

source_record_id.description: The FEC's id of the row (`SUB_ID`), unique within a source.

jurisdiction.description: The regulator whose rules and ids the row follows. `US` (the FEC) for every row of v1.

organization_key.description: The name normalized, its legal form (`INC`, `LLC` …) stripped and its alias applied: rows sharing it are one organization's.

recipient_committee_id.description: The FEC id of the committee that received the gift.

amount.description: The amount in dollars. A refund (types 2nY, 4nY) is negative whatever sign it was filed with, unless it reverses an earlier refund; any other amount is as filed. Refunds and corrections net out in any sum.

date.description: The date of the gift as filed; null when the filer gave none.

entity_type.description: The FEC entity type of the giver (`ORG`), or null when the filing left it blank.

report_type.description: The FEC report the row was filed on (`Q1`, `12G`, `YE` …).

amendment_indicator.description: The FEC amendment indicator of the filing (`N` new, `A` amendment, `T` termination).

memo_text.description: The filer's memo text, as reported.

image_num.description: The FEC image number of the page the row is on.

file_num.description: The FEC filing number of the report the row is on.

classified.description: True when the filing left the entity type blank and fundlens judged the name an organization's.

is_non_contribution_account.description: True for money to a hybrid PAC's non-contribution account, which is outside the contribution limits and outside its organizations' total.

fec_line.description: The line of the FEC form the row is filed on at its recipient (`11(a)(i)`, `party account 31` …), from its transaction type and the filer's transaction id; null when neither places it.

is_other_line.description: True when the row is filed on a line other than 11(a)(i), 11(d), refunds or a non-contribution account: a party account, a transfer. Outside a committee's organizations' total.

is_returned_cost.description: True when the memo names a cost coming back to the committee, not a gift: a tax, vendor or expense refund, rebate or reimbursement, such as the IRS refunding a party's payroll tax. On no list of the organizations that gave most; on line 15 where its transaction type would put it on 11(a)(i), and on its own line otherwise.
